visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional feature band: a large photo with a solid colored text panel offset over its bottom-left corner
visualCharacteristics.layout: Photo inset from the right edge (about 96% width on desktop). A solid red panel (~58% width) overlaps the bottom-left of the photo and extends below it, holding a heading, paragraph and link in white. On mobile the panel stacks under the photo and pulls up over its bottom edge.
visualCharacteristics.notes: Panel color is exposed as --hero-offset-panel-background (default #c41230) and text color as --hero-offset-panel-color for the design pass. JS adds no text, so Spanish pages work unchanged.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: photo only; row 2: heading (H2), paragraph(s), link. Either row may be omitted

usage.description: Mid-page feature band pairing a lifestyle photo with an offset promo panel (e.g. Better Money Habits).

reuseGuidance: Use when a photo carries a solid text panel overlapping its bottom-left corner. For text directly over a full-bleed background image, use hero-offer or the base hero.
